title: Activate grouped windows from alternative activities isnt working for taskmanager
line: Clicking a grouped task whose windows are on another activity now shows them in Window View, and picking one switches to its activity.
explanation: With the task manager set to show Window View on group clicks, it passes the group's window ids to KWin's Window View effect. The effect's model still filtered by the current activity, so when all of the group's windows lived on another activity it showed 'No Windows' and nothing else happened. The change drops the activity filter only in the selected-windows mode, so the requested windows always appear; activating one makes KWin switch to its activity as usual.

commits.message:
plugins/windowview: show selected windows from all activities

When the task manager opened Window View for a group whose windows were
all on another activity, the view only kept windows on the current one
and showed No Windows. Windows passed by id now show on any activity.

BUG: 397017

+                activity: container.effect.mode === WindowView.ModeWindowGroup ? undefined : KWinComponents.Workspace.currentActivity
                 desktop: {
                     switch (container.effect.mode) {
                         case WindowView.ModeCurrentDesktop:

review.text: Minimal, well-placed one-line fix in KWin's Window View effect that clears the activity filter in WindowView.ModeWindowGroup, mirroring the existing desktop filter behavior right below it. This cleanly handles grouped tasks whose windows live on another activity or across multiple activities without affecting Expose, ExposeAll, or ExposeClass, and the before/after screenshots verify both display and activity switching on activation.

reviews.text: Minimal, well-placed one-line fix in KWin's Window View effect that clears the activity filter in WindowView.ModeWindowGroup, mirroring the existing desktop filter behavior right below it. This cleanly handles grouped tasks whose windows live on another activity or across multiple activities without affecting Expose, ExposeAll, or ExposeClass, and the before/after screenshots verify both display and activity switching on activation.

Correct diagnosis and layer: Window View's WindowFilterModel kept the current-activity filter even in ModeWindowGroup, where the caller passes explicit window ids, so a task-manager group on another activity gave 'No Windows'. The one-line change resets the activity filter (the property has a RESET, the same undefined pattern already used for desktop) only in that mode, so explicitly requested windows always appear and activating one switches activity through normal KWin activation; other modes keep the filter, which the regression notes confirm. Before/after screenshots show the empty view and then both Dolphins plus the activated window. It also handles mixed groups across activities, which a task-manager-side activity switch would not.
